-- Two fictional modules in one file: an SMIv2 extension of ACME-SUBSTATION-MIB and an
-- SMIv1 trap module. The extension also holds one broken and one unknown definition.
ACME-EXT-MIB DEFINITIONS ::= BEGIN

IMPORTS
    OBJECT-TYPE, Integer32
        FROM SNMPv2-SMI
    acmeObjects
        FROM ACME-SUBSTATION-MIB;

acmeExt OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { acmeObjects 9 }

acmeExtVoltage OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    UNITS       "V"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Busbar voltage."
    ::= { acmeExt 1 }

acmeExtBroken OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "This definition has no OID value."

acmeExtFancy VENDOR-MACRO
    COLOUR      blue
    ::= { acmeExt 3 }

acmeExtCurrent OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    UNITS       "A"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Feeder current."
    ::= { acmeExt 4 }

END

ACME-V1-MIB DEFINITIONS ::= BEGIN

IMPORTS
    enterprises, Counter, IpAddress
        FROM RFC1155-SMI
    OBJECT-TYPE
        FROM RFC-1212
    TRAP-TYPE
        FROM RFC-1215;

acmeV1      OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { iso org(3) dod(6) internet(1) private(4) enterprises(1) 99999 50 }

acmeV1Alarms OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX  Counter
    ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS  mandatory
    DESCRIPTION
            "Alarms raised since start."
    ::= { acmeV1 1 }

acmeV1Peer OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX  IpAddress
    ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS  mandatory
    ::= { acmeV1 2 }

acmeV1Alarm TRAP-TYPE
    ENTERPRISE  acmeV1
    VARIABLES   { acmeV1Alarms }
    DESCRIPTION "An alarm was raised."
    ::= 7

END
